a.lede: Photos shared online showed faults appearing on the screens of Apple's first foldable device.
a.title: Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo handsets with screen problems

b.lede: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing 'a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.'
b.title: The original Apple iPod debuted 25 years ago today
